df = pd.DataFrame({'CountyName': ['MONTGOMERY', 'JEFFERSON', 'AUTAUGA', 'ELMORE', 'CHEROKEE', 'LEE', 'ETOWAH', 'ELMORE', 'SHELBY', 'CRENSHAW', 'ANCHORAGE', 'COMFEE', 'CHILTUN', 'CHEROKEE', 'MARSHALL', 'MARION', 'MONTGOMERY', 'MONTGOMERY', 'COVINGTON', 'MOBILE']})

df['Has_Emergency_Services'] = df['CountyName'].apply(lambda x: 'Yes' if 'EMERGENCY' in x.lower() else 'No')

count = df[df['Has_Emergency_Services'] == 'Yes'].shape[0]
print(count)
